description: Read a whole website or one section of it (for example every page under /docs) as clean Markdown: starts at a URL, follows same-site links breadth-first and returns up to 20 pages with title and description. Use for documentation, product catalogs or company sites. For one page use web-scrape, for a known list of URLs web-read-batch. Charged only if at least one page was read. Params: url (required), max_pages (1 to 20, default 5), max_chars per page (500 to 20000, default 4000), path_prefix (e.g. /docs). Price: $0.015 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://agentsvc.io/docs","max_pages":3,"max_chars":2000}.

path_prefix.description: Only follow links whose path starts with this, e.g. /docs
